snippet.title: Orbitals | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Space for two?

Watch Creative Director - Marcos Ramos, and Game Director - Jakob Lundgren as they team up to overcome intergalactic challenges in this brand new gameplay reveal of Orbitals!!

Orbitals is launching exclusively on Nintendo Switch™ 2 this Summer!!

Orbitals is a 2-player sci-fi adventure in a retro anime universe, developed by Shapefarm & published by Kepler Interactive!

Find out more: https://www.orbitalsgame.com/linkhub
